transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, August 21. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 8-0 becomes 8-1: 'Impatient' PV Sindhu falls to cramping Wang Zhi Yi in epic duel. PV Sindhu's World Championships campaign ended in controversy as Wang Zhi Yi overcame cramps, a hostile Delhi crowd and the five-time medallist to snap her unbeaten record against Chinese shuttlers at the Worlds. Ayush Shetty also bowed out, while Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand and Satwik-Chirag marched into the quarter-finals. Ex-SC judge Subhash Reddy to lead probe into action on CJP Parliament march. To Examine Checks For Sedition Law Misuse Gates Foundation makes landmark 10-yr donation to Washington University to strengthen . The Gates Foundation has awarded a significant donation to the University of Washington's health institute. This substantial grant will expand the Global Burden of Disease study's reach. IHME will now cover nearly 5,000 locations, providing more detailed local health information. The funding also supports health forecasting and global health spending research efforts. US envoy in Ladakh, may meet Dalai Lama in first trip since Galwan clash. SRINAGAR: A day after meeting Jammu and Kashmir chief minister Omar Abdullah in Srinagar, US Ambassador to India, Sergio Gor, arrived in Ladakh Thursday on his maiden visit to the Union Territory, where he went sightseeing and rafting. Ex-Pak PM Imran Khan moved to private hospital from prison after SC order. Imprisoned former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan was shifted from Adiala prison to a private hospital in Islamabad after midnight Thursday for a medical examination, news agency AP reported citing Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party's statement. Gandhi manuscript fetches rupees 16.2 crore at Saffronart, sets world auction record. A thought for the day isn't just a WhatsApp forward; it can be worth a fortune if it's written in Bapu's hand. How an ex-Buddhist monk and Meta engineer founded a startup that now rivals Accenture. Lilly Chen, a former Buddhist monk and Meta software engineer, founded Contenda after a hackathon. She and three friends turned a pandemic-era project into a successful startup. The company focuses on helping businesses repurpose technical content effectively. Contenda secured one million dollars in pre-seed funding in March 2021. Brazilian mother and daughter built seven-bedroom home from 8,000 glass bottles. A visionary mother and daughter duo transformed sustainability into an art form, building a seven-room home out of more than 8,000 recycled glass bottles. Incorporating elements like reclaimed wood and toothpaste tubes, this remarkable endeavor addresses the dual challenges of beach pollution and housing shortages in Brazil. Named the Salt House, it stands as a sustainable residence and an inspiring venue for community education on environmental responsibility and innovative reuse. 6 Indians on board hijacked cargo ship carrying Turkish weapons off Somalia's coast. Six Indians were among the 10-member crew of a Cameroon-flagged cargo ship hijacked by pirates off Somalia's Puntland coast earlier this week, news agency AP reported citing a Somali official on Thursday. Told he had months to live, Seattle shipbuilder survived another 38 years. Robert Moran, Seattle's former mayor, made a monumental gift of thousands of acres for a state park. Following a serious illness, he relocated to Orcas Island, where he developed picturesque forest lands into a personal estate. His visionary donation led to the establishment of Washington's first state park, named Moran State Park in his honor, which remains a beloved destination to this day. Canadian wildfires cut solar power by 6.38 TWh, caused $1.9bn loss in 2023. Wildfire smoke significantly reduced solar power generation across North America and Europe. This reduction caused substantial economic losses and increased carbon emissions. Other air pollution sources like automobiles also impact solar panel productivity. Wildfires can also physically damage solar farm equipment and infrastructure.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Dollar rebounds from losses sparked by Treasury buyback plan. GLOBAL-FOREX/ (UPDATE 6):FOREX Sebi permits digitally signed power of attorney to ease FPI onboarding. Sebi eases FPI onboarding with digital powers of attorney, while Gaja Capital's IPO gains traction and NSE weighs allowing its shares to trade on its own platform Canadian dollar hits near 3-month high as oil prices climb. CANADA-FOREX/:CANADA FX DEBT-Canadian dollar hits near 3-month high as oil prices climb HDFC Bank raises $1.75 billion in dollar bonds, taps RBI swap window. India's largest private sector lender seeks to tap three- and five-year bonds in its second dollar issuance in two months, as banks capitalise on RBI's concessional swap window Crude oil prices surge to near one-month high as US prepares sweeping sanctions on Iran. Crude oil prices reach near one -month highs as the US plans extensive sanctions against Iran, aiming to isolate the country economically. Brent crude rose almost $3 to $92 a barrel while WTI jumped 3.3 percent to $86.72, amid rising tensions and Trump's warnings about economic penalties. Active derivatives traders fall 18 percent in FY26 to 8.75 million: Sebi study. Individual traders' aggregate net losses declined 18 per cent to rupees 91,685 crore, but the average net loss per trader rose 2.4 per cent to rupees 1.17 lakh in FY26 US Treasury to double long-term bond buybacks; Bessent signals fiscal push as each could top $4 billion. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Treasury bond buybacks could exceed $4 billion per issue, after the department announced plans to at least double purchases of longer-dated debt. He also signalled a stronger fiscal consolidation push to curb the deficit and reduce borrowing costs. Nifty snaps 7-day losing streak as US Treasury move eases yield pressure. Sensex rises 628 points and Nifty gains 154 points as easing US bond-yield pressure lifts sentiment, though elevated crude prices and geopolitical risks remain key headwinds Augmont Enterprises raises rupees 246 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO launch on Friday. Augmont Enterprises raised rupees 246.29 crore from 14 anchor investors ahead of its IPO opening on Friday. The company allotted 31.25 lakh shares at rupees 788 each. The IPO's price band is rupees 750–788, aiming to raise rupees 825 crore for working capital and general corporate purposes. INR seen supported by dollar weakness and positive equities. The Indian rupee pared initial gains and settled for the day with gains of just 3 paise at 95.70 against the US dollar on Thursday, as the support from the weaker dollar index was negated by elevated crude oil prices. A weaker US dollar eases some depreciation pressure on the domestic currency but crude oil hovering above USD 90 is likely to keep pressure on India's import bill. The dollar index fell to its lowest level since late May after the US Treasury announced that it would double its buyback operations for longer-dated Treasury bonds, pushing US long-term yields lower and reducing the dollar's yield advantage. Positive gains from local equities also kept rupee supported. Retail F and O losses ease, but frequent traders continue to bear the brunt. Individual traders' losses fall to rupees 91,685 crore, but average loss rose 2 percent as participation declined 18 percent . Shankesh Jewellers IPO subscribed 2.80 times. The offer received bids for 7.74 crore shares as against 2.76 crore shares on offer. Walmart shares plunge 10 percent to 9-month low after slowest US sales growth in six years. Walmart's shares dropped 10 percent to a nine-month low after missing quarterly sales estimates for the first time in over five years. Rising gasoline prices led to reduced consumer spending, and US comparable sales growth slowed to 2.6 percent . Despite challenges, Walmart raised its full-year sales guidance. Sunshine Pictures IPO subscribed 105.81 times. The offer received bids for 58.04 crore shares as against 54.86 lakh shares on offer. Saatvik Green Energy arm bags rupees 190 crore solar PV module order. Saatvik Green Energy's subsidiary has secured a rupees 190 crore order for solar PV modules, marking its second significant order in recent weeks. Gaja Alternative Asset Management IPO subscribed 2.43 times. The offer received bids for 6.16 crore shares as against 2.53 crore shares on offer. GLP-1 boom feeds into side effects market. The rising use of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs such as Ozempic and Mounjaro is creating a new consumer market in India, with companies developing protein- and fibre-rich foods, nutrition supplements and beauty products aimed at addressing side effects of rapid weight loss. Wall Street stocks edge lower as bond yields rebound, Walmart sinks 8 percent. As of 10:15 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 slipped 0.4 percent , the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.8 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite was 0.7 percent lower. Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO subscribed 5.93 times. The offer received bids for 8.99 crore shares as against 1.51 crore shares on offer. Bain looks to drive into JBM Auto's EV biz. Bain Capital is in discussions with JBM Auto to invest up to rupees 2,850 crore for a significant minority stake in its electric vehicle business, people familiar with the matter said. US stock market today: Wall Street futures remain flat amid concerns over rising bond yields, oil jitters. US stock futures indicated a cautious start as major indices turned negative due to rising crude oil prices and bond yields. The Dow lost 246 points, following a brief recovery due to the Treasury's debt buyback increase amid concerns over budget deficits and inflation. Nifty breaks losing streak, Sensex rallies 628 points; sugar stocks shine. Key equity benchmarks staged a strong rebound on Thursday, with the Nifty snapping a seven-session losing streak and reclaiming the 24,200 level, while the Sensex jumped over 600 points. The recovery was supported by easing US Treasury yields after the US Treasury announced plans to double its buybacks of longer-duration government debt, helping steady global bond markets and improve risk appetite. Buying was broad-based, led by IT, financials, realty and media stocks, while the broader market also ended higher. The rupee snapped its three-day losing streak and closed at 95.71 per dollar. NASA abandons attempt to rescue aging telescope. NASA and Katalyst Space Technologies have ended their mission to save the Swift Observatory. Bitcoin rallies past $70,000 as falling US yields, Trump's crypto meeting boost optimism. Bitcoin crossed $70,000 for the first time in over two months, driven by falling US Treasury yields, Trump's meeting with crypto executives and strong ETF inflows. Ether, Solana and XRP also gained, while short-position liquidations surged. Quick Wrap: Nifty Media Index records a surge of 2.13 percent. Powered by Capital Market 6.6 magnitude earthquake strikes Peru. A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck Central Peru on Thursday, according to the German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ). NTPC to JSW Energy: Axis Direct recommends these three power and utility stocks to buy after Q1. Axis Direct is optimistic about NTPC, Skipper, and JSW Energy following their June-quarter results. They believe strong capacity additions and order books will support earnings growth, maintaining 'Buy' ratings and target prices of rupees 420, rupees 605, and rupees 630, respectively.
